name: io.github.sorcha-platform/sorcha
description: Verifiable-credential & distributed-register platform exposed as MCP tools for AI workflow automation.
_tiered_surface: Tools are tier-gated (F136): consumer tokens see citizen self-service + workflow-participation tools; platform tokens with the admin/designer role additionally see those slices. The served set is authoritative; this manifest advertises it.
_tools_note: Spec 139 US5 (T041): the tools list below MUST match the [McpServerTool(Name=...)] set in the Sorcha.McpServer assembly and the gateway appsettings.json McpManifest catalogue EXACTLY. ManifestIntegrityTests fails build-and-test on any drift. sorcha_wallet_sign is intentionally absent (T029 — de-registered, returns in a dedicated security-reviewed wave).

environmentVariables.name: SORCHA_JWT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Sorcha JWT bearer token scoping the MCP tools to the caller's trust tier (F136) and organisation. Obtain via scripts/get-jwt-token.sh or the Tenant Service auth flow.

environmentVariables.name: SORCHA_GATEWAY_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Sorcha API gateway the MCP server targets (e.g. https://n1.sorcha.dev).

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <Sorcha JWT>. The Streamable HTTP transport (spec 139 US3) is a protected resource: the per-request bearer is validated against the installation issuer + tier audiences before dispatch.
